parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT value FROM leads.system_settings WHERE key='automatic_outreach_enabled'),'true') AS kill_switch, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM leads.system_settings WHERE key='qualification_threshold'),'55')::int AS threshold, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM leads.system_settings WHERE key='daily_send_cap'),'15')::int AS cap, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM leads.outreach_runs WHERE run_date=current_date AND status='completed') AS run_done

INSERT INTO leads.outreach_runs (run_date, status, threshold_used, cap_used) VALUES (current_date, 'running', $1, $2) ON CONFLICT (run_date) DO UPDATE SET status='running', started_at=now(), finished_at=NULL, abort_reason=NULL, threshold_used=EXCLUDED.threshold_used, cap_used=EXCLUDED.cap_used

SELECT c.id, c.business_name, c.address, c.suburb, c.email, c.phone, c.website, c.qualification_score, c.duplicate_of, c.do_not_contact, c.excluded_from_outreach, s.code AS segment_code, c.enrichment->'profile' AS profile FROM leads.candidates c LEFT JOIN leads.segments s ON s.id = c.segment_id LEFT JOIN leads.outreach_drafts d ON d.candidate_id = c.id LEFT JOIN leads.crm_records cr ON cr.candidate_id = c.id WHERE c.duplicate_of IS NULL AND c.stage = 'qualified' AND c.do_not_contact = false AND c.excluded_from_outreach = false AND c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> '' AND c.qualification_score >= $1 AND (d.candidate_id IS NULL OR d.status <> 'sent') AND (cr.candidate_id IS NULL OR (cr.status = 'active' AND cr.stage = 'new')) ORDER BY c.qualification_score DESC NULLS LAST, c.qualified_at ASC NULLS LAST, c.id ASC LIMIT 45

UPDATE leads.outreach_runs SET status='completed', finished_at=now(), sent_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM leads.outreach_queue WHERE run_date=current_date AND status='sent'), skipped_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM leads.outreach_queue WHERE run_date=current_date AND status='skipped'), failed_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM leads.outreach_queue WHERE run_date=current_date AND status='failed') WHERE run_date=current_date

INSERT INTO leads.outreach_queue (run_date, candidate_id, business_name, qualification_score, status) VALUES (current_date, $1::bigint, $2, $3::int, 'scheduled') ON CONFLICT (run_date, candidate_id) DO UPDATE SET business_name=EXCLUDED.business_name, qualification_score=EXCLUDED.qualification_score, status='scheduled', updated_at=now()

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.outreach_queue WHERE run_date=current_date AND status='sent') AS sent_so_far, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM leads.system_settings WHERE key='automatic_outreach_enabled'),'true') AS kill_switch, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM leads.system_settings WHERE key='daily_send_cap'),'15')::int AS cap, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM leads.system_settings WHERE key='qualification_threshold'),'55')::int AS threshold

parameters.query: UPDATE leads.outreach_queue SET status='skipped', reason=$1, updated_at=now() WHERE run_date=current_date AND candidate_id=$2

WITH r AS (INSERT INTO leads.outreach_runs (run_date, status, abort_reason, threshold_used, cap_used) SELECT current_date, 'aborted', $1, $2::int, $3::int WHERE NOT $4::boolean ON CONFLICT (run_date) DO UPDATE SET status='aborted', abort_reason=EXCLUDED.abort_reason, finished_at=now(), threshold_used=EXCLUDED.threshold_used, cap_used=EXCLUDED.cap_used RETURNING run_date) INSERT INTO leads.notifications (type, title, message, severity) SELECT 'outreach_aborted', 'Daily outreach aborted', $1, 'error' FROM r WHERE $5::boolean

WITH send_ok AS (SELECT ($1::text IS NULL) AS ok), ins_draft AS (INSERT INTO leads.outreach_drafts (candidate_id, subject, body, method, status, sent_at, sent_to, sent_by, message_id) SELECT $2::bigint, $3, $4, 'daily_auto_v1', 'sent', now(), $5, 'daily_auto_engine', $6 FROM send_ok WHERE ok ON CONFLICT (candidate_id) DO UPDATE SET subject = EXCLUDED.subject, body = EXCLUDED.body, method = EXCLUDED.method, status = 'sent', sent_at = now(), sent_to = EXCLUDED.sent_to, sent_by = 'daily_auto_engine', message_id = EXCLUDED.message_id, updated_at = now() RETURNING candidate_id), crm_upsert AS (INSERT INTO leads.crm_records (candidate_id, status, stage, source, added_by, last_contact_at) SELECT $2::bigint, 'active', 'contacted', 'sent', 'daily_auto_engine', now() FROM send_ok WHERE ok ON CONFLICT (candidate_id) DO UPDATE SET stage = CASE WHEN leads.crm_records.stage = 'new' THEN 'contacted' ELSE leads.crm_records.stage END, last_contact_at = now(), updated_at = now() RETURNING candidate_id, stage), stage_log AS (INSERT INTO leads.crm_stage_history (candidate_id, stage, changed_by) SELECT candidate_id, stage, 'daily_auto_engine' FROM crm_upsert WHERE stage = 'contacted' RETURNING candidate_id), notif AS (INSERT INTO leads.notifications (type, candidate_id, title, message) SELECT 'daily_outreach_sent', c.id, 'Daily outreach sent', 'Automated daily outreach sent to ' || c.business_name || '.' FROM ins_draft JOIN leads.candidates c ON c.id = ins_draft.candidate_id RETURNING id), q_sent AS (UPDATE leads.outreach_queue SET status='sent', reason=NULL, email_generated=true, sent_at=now(), message_id=$6, crm_updated=EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_upsert), notification_created=EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM notif), updated_at=now() WHERE run_date=current_date AND candidate_id=$2::bigint AND $1::text IS NULL RETURNING candidate_id), q_failed AS (UPDATE leads.outreach_queue SET status='failed', reason=$1, email_generated=true, updated_at=now() WHERE run_date=current_date AND candidate_id=$2::bigint AND $1::text IS NOT NULL RETURNING candidate_id) SELECT $1::text AS send_error, (SELECT candidate_id FROM q_sent) AS sent_candidate, (SELECT candidate_id FROM q_failed) AS failed_candidate
